custom_logic_notes: Core trading signal depends entirely on the external Freeman custom indicator (iCustom call). The EA reads buffer values from this indicator to determine buy/sell signals. Without understanding the Freeman indicator's internal algorithm (which is a separate .ex5 file), the signal generation logic cannot be fully replicated in Python. Digit adjustment logic multiplies SL/TP by 10 for 5-digit brokers. Signal reversal closes existing opposite positions before entering new ones.
python_conversion_notes: The Freeman custom indicator's algorithm must be reverse-engineered or obtained as source code before Python conversion is possible. The iCustom call cannot be directly replicated in Python without knowing the indicator's computation. If the indicator source is unavailable, the signal logic would need to be reimplemented from scratch or the indicator values would need to be pre-exported from MT5. The position management, SL/TP with digit adjustment, new bar detection, and margin check logic are straightforward to convert once the signal source is resolved.
